versions.changelog: 1.4.2: bounded-memory pack/unpack SLOs, 5000-file packages, remote-search telemetry gates

1.3.0: zstd for text (archive 6.2x smaller on the CI text profile; missing zstandard now warns instead of silently falling back to deflate), measured process-pool packing with --workers N (2.3-3.7x on real work, 0.76x on tiny inputs so it is chosen only above 16 MiB), vanished files reported as skipped, adaptive buffer measured and rejected, tests 76 -> 83
1.2.2: single source of truth for the version (CLI reported 0.1.0-mvp while pyproject said 1.2.1); tests/test_version.py fails the build on drift; suite 76 tests

1.2.1: report skipped files (skipped/skipped_count/skipped_by_reason + CLI warning), fix bin/var/etc path policy (only leading system dirs refused), add pack --no-index (169 MiB -> 29.7 MiB peak RSS on a 64.1 MiB text tree), avoid aborting a directory walk on one symlink, TOOL_VERSION 1.2.1

1.2.0: new doctor, selfcheck and badge commands (environment + repository readiness, 2 MiB hello-world run with real RSS, flat SVG SLO badge); optional zstandard resolved lazily; release notes cover the environment-dependent codec defect and the CI zstandard matrix.
1.1.1: QA grade A - frontmatter version/tools, main entry point, sharper description and registry short description
Initial release: smoke/manual/check-telemetry helper, SID/telemetry invariant checks, CI gates
